bottleneck.description: ~95%+ global share of MicroThin ultra-thin copper foil with carrier — the enabling input for HDI substrates, ABF/IC substrates, and advanced packaging (CoWoS/SLP/MSAP) used in AI accelerators.

dependency.key_customers: Substrate makers (Ibiden, Shinko, Unimicron, Nan Ya PCB, AT&S), HDI PCB makers, automotive electronics, EV battery materials customers, exhaust catalyst auto OEMs
dependency.key_suppliers: Copper cathode feedstock, zinc/lead concentrate from Mitsui group mines, indium/tantalum/tin for functional materials

editorial.notes: Mitsui Kinzoku is effectively a near-monopoly supplier of carrier-attached ultra-thin copper foil (<=5um) used in the highest-density semiconductor packaging substrates and HDI smartphone boards — the very materials that gate CoWoS, FC-BGA, and advanced AI-server substrates. Lower-tier peelable copper foil has alternatives at JX Nippon Mining & Furukawa, but Mitsui dominates the leading-edge MicroThin tier the AI substrate roadmap depends on. Not rated CRITICAL because substitutes exist at lower-tier nodes and Mitsui has been adding capacity, but the AI-packaging dependency is real and switching cost (re-qualification at substrate makers Ibiden/Unimicron/Shinko) is multi-year.
